mapper.select: SELECT connected_id FROM user WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT a.id AS id, a.company AS company, a.number AS number, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM account_record ar WHERE ar.account_id = a.id ) AS has_records FROM account a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.id
SELECT c.id AS id, c.company AS company, c.number AS number, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_record cr WHERE cr.card_id = c.id ) AS has_records FROM card c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO last_sync ( user_id, last_sync_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{lastSyncAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE last_sync SET last_sync_at = #{lastSyncAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO account_record ( account_id, source_key, transaction_date, transaction_time, out_amount, in_amount, after_transaction_balance, description1, description2, description3, description4, raw_data ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{sourceKey}, #{transactionDate}, #{transactionTime}, #{outAmount}, #{inAmount}, #{afterTransactionBalance}, #{description1}, #{description2}, #{description3}, #{description4}, CAST(#{rawData} AS JSON) )

INSERT IGNORE INTO card_record ( card_id, source_key, used_date, used_time, store_name, used_amount, payment_type, installment_month, approval_no, payment_due_date, domestic_foreign_type, store_corp_no, store_type, store_no, cancel_yn, cancel_amount, vat, cash_back, krw_amount, currency, raw_data ) VALUES ( #{cardId}, #{sourceKey}, #{usedDate}, #{usedTime}, #{storeName}, #{usedAmount}, #{paymentType}, #{installmentMonth}, #{approvalNo}, #{paymentDueDate}, #{domesticForeignType}, #{storeCorpNo}, #{storeType}, #{storeNo}, #{cancelYn}, #{cancelAmount}, #{vat}, #{cashBack}, #{krwAmount}, #{currency}, #{rawData} )
mapper.select: SELECT cr.id, cr.card_id, cr.source_key, cr.used_date, cr.used_time, cr.store_name, cr.used_amount, cr.payment_type, cr.installment_month, cr.approval_no, cr.payment_due_date, cr.domestic_foreign_type, cr.store_corp_no, cr.store_type, cr.store_no, cr.cancel_yn, cr.cancel_amount, cr.vat, cr.cash_back, cr.krw_amount, cr.currency, cr.raw_data, cr.created_at FROM card_record cr JOIN card c ON c.id = cr.card_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND ( #{lastSyncAt} IS NULL OR cr.created_at > #{lastSyncAt} ) ORDER BY cr.created_at, cr.id

SELECT ar.id, ar.account_id, ar.source_key, ar.transaction_date, ar.transaction_time, ar.out_amount, ar.in_amount, ar.after_transaction_balance, ar.description1, ar.description2, ar.description3, ar.description4, ar.raw_data, ar.created_at FROM account_record ar JOIN account a ON a.id = ar.account_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND ( #{lastSyncAt} IS NULL OR ar.created_at > #{lastSyncAt} ) ORDER BY ar.created_at, ar.id
